role: Independent source-only candidate relevance reviewer; external-model assistance, not human review
permitted_material: Original request, reviewed requirements, interests, safe stripped venue identities, historical independent judgments and their exact official evidence. Native relevance schema inspected. Root/benchmark AGENTS.md and documentation admission rules read.
excluded_material: No benchmark README, itineraries, captures, scores, traces, old case reports or version-labelled process material read. No Planner/provider semantic labels used. No paid Planner or Google calls.

compatibility_review.judgment: The old gardens, major-city-sights and views themes have the same meanings as the source-bound current interests. Canonical venue IDs and available identity aids are compatible with the historical exact-venue evidence. Changing trip dates alone does not change thematic relevance. Historical uncertainty and exact-target limitations remain valid; no new-date access or route inference is made.

limitations: Exact model identifier and reasoning configuration are not exposed to this reviewer; no model name is invented. The inherited reviewer metadata gap remains unchanged.
The initial safe venue packet had null names; the coordinator repaired it and the complete identity-only packet was reread before final judgments. No relevance was inferred from names.

The query/open limits do not support exhaustive independent research for every unresolved venue. Each pair is represented, with UNKNOWN where no sufficient exact-venue evidence was inspected. UNKNOWN is not a negative relevance claim.

Some official search extracts provided usable descriptions while direct pages were blocked, failed, or the returned long excerpt did not reach the relevant subsection; these cases are stated in each evidence record.
Current official pages included incidental opening, traffic and date advisories. They were not used for thematic labels or feasibility inference.
Reused evidence preserves historical bytes, hashes, actor and time; the current reviewer performs compatibility/rebinding, not a fabricated historical re-review.
Native research validation is reserved for the coordinator; this worker checks only source hashes, exact evidence copying and 112-by-3 coverage.
